record.question: Dialysis disequilibrium syndrome is primarily due to:
options: Rapid urea removal causing cerebral edema
record.explanation: Answer C: Rapid urea removal causing cerebral edema. Rapid plasma urea removal can create an osmotic gradient that drives water into brain tissue, causing cerebral edema in dialysis disequilibrium syndrome. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sites/books/NBK559018/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
